thread:
minh nguyen: Heads-up — received partial RMA batch at FRA staging. 24 H100s in the shipment, QA flagged 6 with thermal anomalies during power-on. Vendor suggesting split routing: 4 air replacements immediate, 2 next-week. Forwarder quote for expedited AWB is crazy. @olivia can you confirm AWB + brokerage breakdown?
olivia (VendorGen): Sorry about the hit — confirmed serials for the 6: H100-SN[5782,5783,5784,5785,5786,5787]. We can air-ship 4 as DAP tomorrow AM (AWB pending), remaining 2 ship next Tue due to stock. Brokerage estimate: EUR 1,200 total for air, sea is EUR 220.
minh nguyen: Can you paste the AWB when created and include incoterms? Also need estimated delivery windows to REDWOOD-FRA-DC dock (hours).
ops-bot: Auto: INC ticket created INF-2024-986 for RMA-54321. Assigned: ops oncall.
sarah p: What HS code are they clearing under? customs hold will blow the ETA. If AWB goes through, we need dock slot on Wed 06:00-09:00. Can we get broker contact?
olivia (VendorGen): Using HS 8543.70 (electronics) per our exporter. Broker: GlobalFreight-DE, contact +49 30 1234 900, rep: Jana. AWB placeholders: 123-987654321 (air1), 123-987654322 (air2). Incoterm: DAP FRA-DC.
alex r: Quick cost check — expedited air (4 units) vs credit for 2. If vendor will credit at invoice price + return freight, we can accept credit for the 2. Otherwise we push for immediate replacements. What's vendor's position on unit credit vs replacement?
olivia (VendorGen): We can offer either: immediate replacement for 4, backlog-ship 2 next week OR full credit for the 2 units at invoice value minus reuse restocking (we can waive 50% restocking for this batch). We will also absorb EUR 400 of brokerage as good will.
logistics-ops: If we accept split (4 air / credit 2) we need documentation: commercial invoice amendment, RMA confirmation, AWB scan, and debit note for brokerage credit. Send docs to rma@redwoodinfra.com.
minh nguyen: Proposed plan: accept 4 air replacements now, take credit for 2 (so we can reallocate capacity). Condition: vendor provides RCA within 5 business days and provides pre-shipment thermal tests for next 48 units in this PO. Also need explicit AWB + courier tracking and broker waiver note.
olivia (VendorGen): Agreed to those terms. RCA commit: preliminary root-cause within 72 hours, full report in 5 business days. We'll run a 1hr burn-in + thermal cycle test on remaining units before handover and attach results. I'll upload docs to the ticket and email ops.
sarah p: Please include the manifest snippet in the ticket (we need serial-to-sku mapping). Example format below — paste actuals into INF ticket.
```
SKU,HW_TYPE,SERIAL,STATUS
H100-2024,H100,SN5782,DOA-THERMAL
H100-2024,H100,SN5783,DOA-THERMAL
H100-2024,H100,SN5784,DOA-THERMAL
... (etc)
```
logistics-ops: Also need to confirm pickup window with GlobalFreight-DE: they showed availability 07:00-11:00 tomorrow for 4 units. If AWB and customs OK, we slot 07:30 pickup.
minh nguyen: Okay. ops will book dock 07:30-08:30 tomorrow tentative. Alex — please confirm accounting acceptance of vendor credit terms (waive 50% restock + EUR400 brokerage absorbed).
alex r: I'll run approval now, aim to confirm in 30m. If finance pushes back, fallback is to accept replacements for all 6 and we eat brokerage temporarily.
olivia (VendorGen): Uploading initial AWB draft + commercial amendment to INF-2024-986 now. Will mark the two-week backlog for the 2 remaining units and include burn-in logs for the refurbs.
minh nguyen: Thanks. One more ask — if vendor offers temporary loaners to cover capacity hit (we have immediate customer jobs), we'd prefer 6 loaners until replacements/credits settle. Is that possible?
olivia (VendorGen): We can provide 4 loaners immediately and 2 next week (same cadence as replacements). They will be marked loaner units, custody note required.
sarah p: Document custody/serial swap procedure in ticket so we don't break inventory counts. Also include RMA label png.
minh nguyen: Great. I'll monitor INF-2024-986 and close after docs and AWB confirm. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
